english.title: Permit use of a handheld mobile phone / device while driving a motor vehicle on a road - endorsable offence
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) permitted **(..SPECIFY THE PERSON..) to drive a motor vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), on a road, namely **(..SPECIFY ROAD AND LOCATION..), when

(A)_[he]_
(B)_[she]_

was at the time using

(C)_[a hand-held mobile telephone]_
(D)_[a hand-held device, other than a two-way radio, which was capable of transmitting and receiving data, whether or not those capabilities were enabled, namely **(..SPECIFY THE TYPE OF DEVICE..)]_
english.legislation: Contrary to regulation 110(2) of the Road Vehicles (Construction and Use) Regulations 1986, section 41D of the Road Traffic Act 1988 and Schedule 2 to the Road Traffic Offenders Act 1988.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
permitted a person to drive a motor vehicle on a road
when that person was using a hand held mobile telephone/device
thereby failing to comply with a requirement of the R/Vehicles (Con and Use) Reg's 1986
to drive that motor vehicle while in a position which would give proper control or
a full view of the road and traffic ahead

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) This offence applies from the 25th March 2022 due to changes made by SI 2022/81. For the offence applying before this date, see H18724.
(ii) This is an endorseable offence , seeSchedule 2 to the Road Traffic Offenders Act 1988.
(iii) Officers should note the defences to this offence, as provided by regulation 110(5) and (5A) and (5B) of the Road Vehicles (Construction and Use) Regulations 1986.

other.penalty:
Fine not exceeding level three on the standard scale.

A fine not exceeding level four on the standard scale if in respect of goods vehicle or vehicle adapted to carry more than eight passengers.Discretionary disqualification.
